title: Beyond the doors
steps: Through the three doors at last. The stones are older and darker here, and just ahead a long corridor crosses yours.
I am so proud! The loop got us through all three doors in one go.
Listen, steps down there: Dask walks his round along that corridor, and he looks this way a long while.
How do we cross if we do not know how long he looks?
Then we wait exactly as long as he looks. A program can do that.
